Printed-tile jellyfish bell construction — a jellyfish built from a large trans-purple 4×4 dome as the bell, printed 1×2 tile-tentacles and clear bar-rod trailing tendrils hanging beneath on clip-bar connections, mounted on a clear rod mid-water-column float

SNOT sideways wave-curl with foam lip — a mid-break wave built sideways via SNOT bracket-plates curling stacked trans-light-blue slopes into a hollow tube, the leading lip crested with white 1×1 round-plates and white cheese-slopes, foam frozen at peak-break.

Offset jumper-tile ripple seafloor — a seafloor textured by tan + dark-tan 1×2 jumper-plates laid on alternating half-stud offsets across a base of tan plates, scattered white + tan 1×1 round-plates reading as shell-debris and pebbles, dune-slopes mounding at the margins.
